cards.title: Revision River Ferry Draft Checklist Card
cards.draftChecklistSkill: check that dialogue tags are easy to follow
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable composition notebook draft checklist card for checking one fictional revision river ferry story draft on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card beside a composition notebook page and choose one broad made-up ferry draft to check: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: check the ferry draft for character, setting, order, useful details, clear dialogue tags, and one pencil note: ____________________.
cards.characterCheckPrompt: Character check: name the made-up ferry helper and the clear job that moves the story: ____________________.
cards.settingCheckPrompt: Setting check: list two invented ferry setting details, such as a paper pier and folded ticket sign: ____________________.
cards.sequenceCheckPrompt: Sequence check: write the beginning, middle, and ending ferry moments in order: ____________________.
cards.detailCheckPrompt: Detail check: circle one useful ferry detail and cross out one extra detail that does not help: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCheckPrompt: Sentence check: underline one spoken line and make the tag show which made-up character speaks: ____________________.
cards.finalDraftChecklistPrompt: Final draft checklist: write one pencil note about the next ferry draft change: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: complete only the character, setting, and dialogue-tag checks on paper: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Notebook line: use the same checklist with another made-up ferry draft and one clear sentence: ____________________.

cards.title: Chapter Gate Greenhouse Draft Checklist Card
cards.draftChecklistSkill: check that the final sentence feels finished
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable composition notebook draft checklist card for checking one fictional chapter gate greenhouse draft on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set a composition notebook page beside the card and choose one broad made-up chapter gate draft: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: check whether the chapter gate draft has a clear helper, place, order, details, sentences, and ending note: ____________________.
cards.characterCheckPrompt: Character check: name the made-up gate keeper and one job the keeper must finish in the draft: ____________________.
cards.settingCheckPrompt: Setting check: write two invented greenhouse details, such as a page shelf and pointer card: ____________________.
cards.sequenceCheckPrompt: Sequence check: list the first chapter clue, the next clue, and the final gate choice in order: ____________________.
cards.detailCheckPrompt: Detail check: circle one chapter detail that helps the draft and cross out one side detail: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCheckPrompt: Sentence check: rewrite one unclear chapter sentence so the reader knows who found what: ____________________.
cards.finalDraftChecklistPrompt: Final draft checklist: test the final sentence and write one pencil note if it needs a stronger finish: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: check only the final sentence and one useful chapter detail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Notebook line: try the checklist again with another made-up chapter gate draft on paper: ____________________.

cards.title: Index Card Theater Club Draft Checklist Card
cards.draftChecklistSkill: make one pencil note for the next draft
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable composition notebook draft checklist card for checking one fictional index card theater story draft on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place a composition notebook page beside the card and choose one broad made-up theater club draft: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: check what the theater club draft already has, then leave one pencil note for the next draft: ____________________.
cards.characterCheckPrompt: Character check: name the made-up stage helper and the clear job that starts the story: ____________________.
cards.settingCheckPrompt: Setting check: list two invented theater details, such as a cue card rail and prop shelf: ____________________.
cards.sequenceCheckPrompt: Sequence check: write what happens first, what changes next, and how the theater club draft ends: ____________________.
cards.detailCheckPrompt: Detail check: circle one theater detail that helps the story and cross out one extra detail: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCheckPrompt: Sentence check: choose one cloudy sentence and rewrite it with a clearer subject and action: ____________________.
cards.finalDraftChecklistPrompt: Final draft checklist: write one next-draft pencil note that the writer can use later: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the next-draft pencil note after checking the character and setting: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Notebook line: carry the same paper checklist to another made-up theater club draft: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Draft Checklist Card
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable composition notebook draft checklist card for checking one fictional binding day boardwalk draft on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set this card beside a composition notebook page and choose one broad made-up boardwalk draft: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: compare two checklist choices before choosing the pencil note that best helps the boardwalk draft: ____________________.
cards.characterCheckPrompt: Character check: name the made-up booklet helper and compare two possible jobs for that helper: ____________________.
cards.settingCheckPrompt: Setting check: choose two invented boardwalk details, such as a page clasp rail and paper booth: ____________________.
cards.sequenceCheckPrompt: Sequence check: compare two possible next moments and write the one that follows the beginning best: ____________________.
cards.detailCheckPrompt: Detail check: compare two details, then circle the one that helps the draft more: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCheckPrompt: Sentence check: compare two versions of one sentence and copy the version with the clearer subject: ____________________.
cards.finalDraftChecklistPrompt: Final draft checklist: choose one checklist result and write it as the next-draft pencil note: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: compare only two details and one sentence before writing the pencil note: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Notebook line: use two paper choices to help another made-up boardwalk draft grow clearer: ____________________.

cards.title: Margin Note Market Draft Checklist Card
cards.draftChecklistSkill: copy one final checklist note before revising
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable composition notebook draft checklist card for checking one fictional margin note market story draft on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place the card beside a composition notebook page and choose one broad made-up margin note draft: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: check the margin note draft, then copy one final checklist note before any longer revising: ____________________.
cards.characterCheckPrompt: Character check: name the made-up note seller and the clear job that belongs in this story: ____________________.
cards.settingCheckPrompt: Setting check: list two invented market details, such as a margin-note stall and blank tag basket: ____________________.
cards.sequenceCheckPrompt: Sequence check: write the first market moment, the next choice, and the final paper-note result: ____________________.
cards.detailCheckPrompt: Detail check: circle one margin detail that helps the draft and cross out one extra note: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCheckPrompt: Sentence check: rewrite one market sentence so it says exactly who does the action: ____________________.
cards.finalDraftChecklistPrompt: Final draft checklist: copy one final checklist note before the next paper revision begins: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: copy only the final checklist note after checking one character job and one setting detail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Notebook line: save the final checklist note and use it on another made-up margin note draft: ____________________.
